title: Fraunhofer Institute for Manufacturing Technology and Advanced Materials IFAM
content:
Fraunhofer IFAM, headquartered in Bremen with additional sites including Dresden and Stade, is one of Europe's leading independent research institutions for adhesive bonding technology, surfaces, shaping, and functional materials, employing roughly 700 people. Its expertise spans metallic, polymer, and hybrid materials, cellular metals and composite foams, powder metallurgy, and additive manufacturing, from development through processing to qualification.

These capabilities are relevant to aerogel composites and lightweight thermal-management materials: IFAM develops functional and porous composites, characterizes thermal and mechanical performance, and supports scale-up from laboratory to industry, including fiber-reinforced composite systems and CFRP tanks for cryogenic hydrogen. Partners can access customized material development, feasibility studies, and testing services.
